mapper.insert: insert into payment_callback_log (order_no, trade_no, trade_status, raw_payload, verified, processed, success, error_message, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{tradeNo}, #{tradeStatus}, #{rawPayload}, #{verified}, #{processed}, #{success}, #{errorMessage}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update payment_callback_log set verified = #{verified}, processed = #{processed}, success = #{success}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
